label: Real Estate Investment Analysis
description: Analyse real estate investment opportunities with structured evaluation of financial returns, risk factors, market positioning, and strategic fit.

claudeKnowledge.description: Real estate investment underwriting, yield metrics, IRR modelling, market analysis, INREV/MSCI conventions

guidedInputs.label: Market / Location
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Stockholm CBD, Helsinki metro area...

guidedInputs.label: Financial Summary
guidedInputs.placeholder: Key financials: asking price, NOI, yield, occupancy, WAULT, rent roll highlights, capex needs...

guidedInputs.label: Financing Assumptions
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., 55% LTV at 4.2% all-in, 5-year term, ICR covenant 1.8x...

guidedInputs.label: Investment Criteria / Strategy
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe the investor's strategy, return targets (IRR, equity multiple, cash yield), hold period, and risk appetite...

exampleInput: Underwrite this acquisition for our value-add fund: a 1990s logistics property, 18,400 sqm, on the southern edge of Stockholm (Botkyrka), asking SEK 310M. Current NOI SEK 17.4M (5.6% yield at ask), 91% occupied, WAULT 3.2 years; the anchor tenant (42% of rent) expires in 2028. Passing rents are roughly 15% below recent market lettings, and about SEK 25M of capex (roof, LED, solar) is needed to reach EPC B. Financing assumption: 55% LTV at 4.3% all-in, 5-year term, ICR covenant 1.9x. Our targets are 14% net IRR and 1.6x equity multiple over a 5-year hold. Assess the deal against these targets, stress the anchor-tenant and exit-yield assumptions, and give a bid/no-bid recommendation with a defensible price range.

exampleValues.financial-summary: Asking SEK 310M; NOI SEK 17.4M (5.6% at ask); 18,400 sqm, built 1992; 91% occupancy; WAULT 3.2 years; anchor tenant 42% of rent expiring 2028; passing rents ~15% under market; ~SEK 25M capex (roof, LED, solar) to reach EPC B.
exampleValues.financing: 55% LTV at 4.3% all-in, 5-year term, ICR covenant 1.9x
exampleValues.investment-criteria: Value-add fund: 14% net IRR target, 1.6x equity multiple, 5-year hold, moderate-high risk appetite. LP requirement: EPC B minimum by exit.
